decision.scope: Public map/list records and ordinary display of Iowa DOT-hosted still images from the official Traffic Cameras feed, filtered to ORG=IADOT. Video URL metadata is also provided; video playback was not tested.
decision.confidence: High for dataset reuse and no-key access; strong source-supported implementation conclusion for ordinary display of returned Iowa DOT-owned camera media.
decision.summary: Enable the official IADOT subset with visible attribution, source/license links, preserved notices, coordinate validation, and media host checks. No added permission gate is warranted by the reviewed official terms and camera-integrator guidance.

ownership_and_license.dataset_permission: The specific authoritative Traffic Cameras item identifies CC BY 4.0; Iowa DOT current GIS terms permit commercial reuse of licensed datasets and related materials and state site terms do not limit that grant.
ownership_and_license.image_permission_distinction: An item license explicitly establishes the dataset license; a link alone never proves that an unrelated third-party image has the same license. Here every current row identifies ORG=IADOT, every ImageURL is hosted at atmsqf.iowadot.gov, current GIS terms include related materials, and the official May 28 advisory expressly supports media partners/integrators consuming the image and video URLs. Together these support ordinary public display of this DOT-owned camera imagery without a separate contact step. No separate pixel-level license notice was found or required in the reviewed camera guidance. Do not claim the feed licenses all third-party material.
scope_caveats: Keep ORG=IADOT filtering even though all current rows match. Review any future non-IADOT provider before enabling its media.
Preserve image overlays, attribution, copyright notices, and disclaimers; do not imply Iowa DOT endorses MonitorIt.
Data and imagery may be unavailable or stale; do not promise safety-critical or navigation accuracy.

The general website terms contain restrictive language, but the later specific GIS terms explicitly preserve the applicable Creative Commons permissions. Do not use the general wording to nullify the dataset license.

required_elements: Link the source dataset and CC BY 4.0 license
Indicate modifications such as filtering, reformatting, or aggregation
Retain supplied attribution/copyright/license/disclaimer notices and avoid implying endorsement
attribution.recommended_exact_ui_text: Traffic camera data and imagery: Iowa Department of Transportation. Traffic Cameras dataset licensed under CC BY 4.0. Filtered and reformatted by MonitorIt. No Iowa DOT endorsement. Provided as-is; camera views may be delayed or unavailable.
attribution.note: No single mandatory verbatim credit sentence is specified. The proposed wording satisfies the identifiable credit/license/change-notice elements without asserting a separate image-specific license. Put full attribution and terms links in the source details and keep a visible credit on the camera view.

coordinate_fields.geometry_request: Set outSR=4326 if returnGeometry=true; use geometry.x as longitude and geometry.y as latitude only after reprojection.

feed.identity: Each row is a camera view, not necessarily a unique physical camera. FID is the query/pagination key, with no promise of cross-refresh stability. ORG + device_id + ImageURL is unique over all 1,260 current rows. Neither device_id nor COMMON_ID nor ImageName is unique; preserve multiple views. URL migrations can change a URL-derived application ID.

pagination.resultOffset: Advance by returned record count; inspect exceededTransferLimit and continue until exhausted. Check count separately if useful.
pagination.rate_limit: No camera consumer-specific numeric quota found. The generic ArcGIS org request-unit header is not a per-consumer entitlement. Cache and back off on 429/5xx.

refresh.documented_inventory_cadence: Once per day according to authoritative item description.
refresh.recommended_inventory_behavior: Server-side cached daily ingest; preserve last successful inventory. Refresh sooner on discovered URL migration or widespread broken URLs, with bounded backoff. Do not fetch 1,260 rows for every client interaction.
refresh.image_cadence: No fixed image refresh guarantee found. Selected-camera refresh of roughly 60 seconds is an application recommendation, not a published permission or source frequency. Load visible images lazily and avoid refreshing every map marker.
refresh.metadata_timestamp_warning: UpdateDate/UpdateTime are inventory attributes; they were 20261002/163813..163816 while sample images were current on October 3. Do not present them as image-capture freshness.
refresh.image_freshness: Use actual image overlay timestamp or HTTP Last-Modified when available; otherwise label as latest available image, not verified live.

image_tests.visual_inspection: Real roadway/rest-area camera image; no error placeholder. Original text overlays preserved.
Real roadway/rest-area camera image; no error placeholder. Original text overlays preserved.
Real roadway/rest-area camera image; no error placeholder. Original text overlays preserved.

media.image_fetch_context: Unauthenticated public GET; no account, cookie, token, or referer required. JPEG decoding and visual inspection succeeded for one DOT traffic image, one RWIS image, and one rest-area image.
media.cors_note: Image responses did not advertise Access-Control-Allow-Origin in these checks. Ordinary display does not need CORS; fetch/canvas pixel access may need a same-origin proxy. Do not misinterpret absent image CORS as a reuse prohibition.
media.url_handling: Use exact feed-returned URLs, preserve path case, require HTTPS, reject credentials and unexpected hosts/schemes, and do not synthesize URLs. The official migration advisory says image and video URLs can change. Current video hosts retain port 8888; do not strip it.
media.future_media_hosts: The advisory anticipated video.iowadot.gov; enable new hosts after confirming official feed values and DOT ownership, rather than assuming arbitrary third-party URLs are covered.
